# A11Y UI - Complete Documentation & Component API Reference

> Accessibility-first React UI component library built for WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 Level AA & AAA compliance, screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and production design systems.
> Package: `@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components`
> Current Version: 2.3.2
> Homepage: https://ui.a11ypros.com
> Storybook: https://ui.a11ypros.com/storybook-static/index.html
> GitHub: https://github.com/A11YPros/a11y-ui

---

## 1. Getting Started

### Installation
```bash
npm install @a11ypros/a11y-ui-components
# Peer dependencies
npm install react react-dom
```

### Stylesheet Import
Import the stylesheet at the root of your application (e.g., `layout.tsx`, `App.tsx`, or `index.tsx`):
```tsx
// Complete stylesheet with CSS reset, theming tokens, and accessibility enhancements
import '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components/styles';

// Or component-only structural styles (if you provide your own reset)
import '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components/styles/components';
```

### Next.js App Router (RSC) Note
Interactive components (`Menu`, `Menubar`, `Modal`, `Tabs`, `Switch`, `Tooltip`, `Select`, `Accordion`) maintain client state and use DOM events. Import them inside `'use client'` files or wrap them in client boundaries.

---

## 2. Design Tokens & Theming

The library uses a 3-tier CSS custom property contract with fallback defaults. Override on `:root` or with `data-theme="dark"`:

```css
:root {
  /* Brand colors */
  --a11y-color-primary: #0369a1;
  --a11y-color-primary-hover: #075985;
  --a11y-color-primary-active: #0c4a6e;
  --a11y-color-primary-fg: #ffffff;

  /* Surfaces & backgrounds */
  --a11y-color-bg: #ffffff;
  --a11y-color-surface: #fafafa;
  --a11y-color-surface-hover: #f4f4f5;

  /* Text colors */
  --a11y-color-text: #171717;
  --a11y-color-text-muted: #525252;

  /* Borders & focus rings (WCAG 3:1 non-text contrast) */
  --a11y-color-border: #767676;
  --a11y-color-focus: #0ea5e9;
  --a11y-focus-width: 2px;
  --a11y-focus-offset: 2px;

  /* Universal radius */
  --a11y-radius: 0.375rem;
}

[data-theme='dark'] {
  --a11y-color-bg: #09090b;
  --a11y-color-surface: #18181b;
  --a11y-color-surface-hover: #27272a;
  --a11y-color-text: #f4f4f5;
  --a11y-color-text-muted: #a1a1aa;
  --a11y-color-border: #52525b;
}
```

---

## 3. Components Reference

### 3.1 Button
Accessible button supporting primary, secondary, ghost, danger variants, sizes, and accessible loading states.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships), 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.7 (Focus Visible), 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
- **Keyboard**: `Enter` / `Space` activates click. Disabled buttons receive `aria-disabled="true"` or `disabled`.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={() => console.log('Clicked')}>
  Submit Form
</Button>
<Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => console.log('Delete')}>
  Delete Item
</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" loading={true}>
  Saving...
</Button>
```

### 3.2 Menu
Accessible dropdown action menu following the WAI-ARIA Menu Button pattern with roving focus, shortcut keys, and focus restoration.
- **WCAG SC**: 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
- **Keyboard**: `Enter` / `Space` / `ArrowDown` opens menu; `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` roves focus; `Home` / `End` jumps to first/last; `Escape` closes menu and returns focus to trigger.

```tsx
import { Menu, MenuItem, MenuDivider } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Menu trigger={<Button variant="secondary">Options ▾</Button>}>
  <MenuItem shortcut="⌘E" onClick={() => alert('Edit')}>Edit</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem shortcut="⌘D" onClick={() => alert('Duplicate')}>Duplicate</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem disabled>Archive (Disabled)</MenuItem>
  <MenuDivider />
  <MenuItem danger shortcut="⌘⌫" onClick={() => alert('Delete')}>Delete</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

### 3.3 Menubar
Desktop-style horizontal application menu bar (`role="menubar"`) with composite roving tabindex, inter-menu keyboard roving, and hover switching.
- **WCAG SC**: 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), 2.4.7 (Focus Visible), 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
- **Keyboard**: Single tab stop for the whole menubar. `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` cycles through top-level menus. When a menu is open, `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` opens the adjacent menu immediately and focuses its first item.

```tsx
import { Menubar, Menu, MenuItem, MenuDivider } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Menubar label="Application menu">
  <Menu trigger={<button type="button">File</button>}>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘N" onClick={() => alert('New')}>New File</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘O" onClick={() => alert('Open')}>Open...</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘S" onClick={() => alert('Save')}>Save</MenuItem>
    <MenuDivider />
    <MenuItem danger shortcut="⌘Q" onClick={() => alert('Quit')}>Quit</MenuItem>
  </Menu>
  <Menu trigger={<button type="button">Edit</button>}>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘Z" onClick={() => alert('Undo')}>Undo</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘C" onClick={() => alert('Copy')}>Copy</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘V" onClick={() => alert('Paste')}>Paste</MenuItem>
  </Menu>
  <Menu trigger={<button type="button">View</button>}>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘+" onClick={() => alert('Zoom In')}>Zoom In</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem shortcut="⌘-" onClick={() => alert('Zoom Out')}>Zoom Out</MenuItem>
  </Menu>
</Menubar>
```

### 3.4 Modal
Dialog overlay with automatic focus trapping, `Escape` key closing, `aria-modal="true"`, and focus restoration to the trigger.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), 4.1.2
- **Keyboard**: `Tab` cycles only within modal; `Escape` closes modal and returns focus.

```tsx
import { Modal, Button } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function ConfirmModal() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open Modal</Button>
      <Modal isOpen={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Confirm Action">
        <p>Are you sure you want to proceed?</p>
        <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Confirm</Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

### 3.5 Switch
Accessible toggle switch with `role="switch"`, `aria-checked`, and keyboard space toggling.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.4.7, 4.1.2
- **Keyboard**: `Space` or `Enter` toggles state.

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function Settings() {
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Switch
      label="Enable dark mode"
      description="Adjusts contrast and theme automatically"
      checked={enabled}
      onChange={setEnabled}
    />
  );
}
```

### 3.6 Tooltip
Contextual popup description with `role="tooltip"`, `aria-describedby` association, hover and focus triggers, and `Escape` dismissal.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 1.4.13 (Content on Hover or Focus), 2.1.1, 4.1.2
- **Keyboard**: Displays on focus; `Escape` dismisses without losing focus.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, Button } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Tooltip content="Permanently removes the document" position="top">
  <Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

### 3.7 Tabs
WAI-ARIA 1.2 compliant keyboard-navigable tab list (`role="tablist"`), tabs (`role="tab"`), and panels (`role="tabpanel"`).
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 4.1.2
- **Keyboard**: Single tab stop in tab list; `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (or `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` if vertical) switches active tab and moves focus; `Home` / `End` activates first/last.

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Tabs
  items={[
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', content: <p>Overview details</p> },
    { id: 'api', label: 'API Reference', content: <p>API specification</p> },
    { id: 'a11y', label: 'Accessibility', content: <p>WCAG compliance notes</p> },
  ]}
  defaultActiveId="overview"
/>
```

### 3.8 Accordion
WAI-ARIA collapsible disclosure pattern with proper `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 4.1.2
- **Keyboard**: `Enter` / `Space` toggles disclosure; `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` roves between headers.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Accordion
  items={[
    { id: '1', title: 'What is WCAG AA compliance?', content: 'WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA requires 4.5:1 text contrast...' },
    { id: '2', title: 'How does keyboard navigation work?', content: 'All interactive elements are reachable with Tab...' },
  ]}
  allowMultiple={false}
/>
```

### 3.9 Banner
Status and alert messaging banner supporting semantic `role="status"` or `role="alert"` (with live region announcements) and dismiss callback.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1, 4.1.3 (Status Messages)

```tsx
import { Banner } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Banner variant="success" title="Profile saved successfully">
  Your preferences have been persisted to the server.
</Banner>
<Banner variant="danger" title="Connection error" dismissible onDismiss={() => console.log('Dismissed')}>
  Could not synchronize changes. Please check your network.
</Banner>
```

### 3.10 DataTable
Accessible data grid with sortable column headers (`aria-sort="ascending" | "descending"`) and row selection.
- **WCAG SC**: 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships - `<th>`, `<caption>`, `scope="col"`), 2.1.1

```tsx
import { DataTable } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Component', sortable: true },
  { key: 'wcag', header: 'WCAG Level', sortable: true },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status' },
];

const data = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Menu', wcag: 'AA / AAA', status: 'Stable' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Menubar', wcag: 'AA / AAA', status: 'Stable' },
];

<DataTable caption="Component Accessibility Conformance" columns={columns} data={data} />
```

### 3.11 Form Controls: Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Fieldset, Label
All form primitives link labels to inputs via `htmlFor`/`id`, associate helper text and error messages via `aria-describedby`, and mark required fields with `aria-required="true"`.

```tsx
import {
  Input,
  Textarea,
  Select,
  Checkbox,
  Radio,
  Fieldset,
  Label,
} from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

// Input with validation error announced to screen readers
<Input
  label="Work Email"
  type="email"
  required
  placeholder="you@company.com"
  errorMessage="Please enter a valid work email address"
/>

// Textarea with character count
<Textarea
  label="Project Feedback"
  maxLength={500}
  showCount
  placeholder="Share your thoughts..."
/>

// Select with keyboard navigation
<Select
  label="Country"
  options={[
    { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
    { value: 'ca', label: 'Canada' },
    { value: 'uk', label: 'United Kingdom' },
  ]}
  value="us"
  onChange={(val) => console.log(val)}
/>

// Checkbox
<Checkbox
  id="terms"
  label="I accept the accessibility guidelines"
  checked={true}
  onChange={(checked) => console.log(checked)}
/>

// Radio group in semantic Fieldset
<Fieldset legend="Select Color Theme">
  <Radio name="theme" label="System Default" value="system" defaultChecked />
  <Radio name="theme" label="High Contrast" value="high-contrast" />
</Fieldset>
```

### 3.12 Link
Semantic anchor tag with external link detection (`rel="noopener noreferrer"`), external icon indicators, and visible focus rings.
- **WCAG SC**: 2.4.4 (Link Purpose in Context), 2.4.7

```tsx
import { Link } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

<Link href="/getting-started">Read the guide</Link>
<Link href="https://w3.org/WAI" external>W3C Accessibility Guidelines</Link>
```

---

## 4. Accessibility Hooks & Utilities

Exported hooks and utilities for custom component development:

### `useFocusTrap(containerRef, isActive)`
Traps keyboard `Tab` and `Shift+Tab` cycles strictly within the referenced container element.

### `useFocusReturn(isActive)`
Captures the currently active element when an overlay opens and restores focus back to it when the overlay closes.

### `useAriaLive()`
Manages dynamic announcements to screen readers using polite or assertive live regions:
```tsx
import { useAriaLive } from '@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components';

const { announce } = useAriaLive();
announce('3 items added to cart', 'polite');
```

### Utilities
- `announceToScreenReader(message: string, priority?: 'polite' | 'assertive')`
- `trapFocus(element: HTMLElement, event: KeyboardEvent)`
- `getKeyboardFocusableElements(container: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[]`
- `handleArrowNavigation(event: KeyboardEvent, elements: HTMLElement[], currentIndex: number, options?: { orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical', loop?: boolean }): number`
